world.title: Ground-floor wall upgrade solution
world.problemStatement: Rising damp has damaged the ground-floor masonry wall; the damaged section must be removed, rebuilt with concrete blocks and re-plastered.

steps.title: Reconstruct / open the current building reality
steps.detail: opened the observed building reality pinned to Reality-Graph version 'rgv-demo-0007' — 4 observed element(s), read-only; the baseline surface facts anchor coated operations through the engine's read-only resolver

steps.title: Select the engineering problem
steps.detail: selected the engineering problem of case 'case-demo-wall-001': Rising damp has damaged the ground-floor masonry wall; the damaged section must be removed, rebuilt with concrete blocks and re-plastered.

links.label: case case-demo-wall-001 (Engineering Case)

steps.title: Create the interactive solution
steps.detail: created solution 'solution-demo-001' — version 1, layer 0 (the baseline overlay over the pinned observed reality); the proposal starts empty

steps.title: Manipulate directly — demolition-removal
steps.detail: selected Damaged ground-floor wall faces in the drawing and executed the direct-manipulation action 'demolition-removal' — the typed intent flows through the ONE submission path into the engine

steps.title: Use agent commands — block-wall-placement
steps.detail: asked the agent: 'Rebuild the damaged wall with blocks.' (after a clarification: height, material) — the confirmed proposal applies through THE SAME submission path as direct manipulation, over The wall line along the damaged section

operation.commandText: Rebuild the damaged wall with blocks.

steps.title: Use agent commands — plaster-application
steps.detail: asked the agent: 'Apply 30 mm plaster to the affected wall faces.' — the confirmed proposal applies through THE SAME submission path as direct manipulation, over Damaged ground-floor wall faces

operation.commandText: Apply 30 mm plaster to the affected wall faces.

steps.title: Step through the proposed layers/states
steps.detail: stepped the timeline back to layer 1 (state cb7cc34aa2a8…) and forward to the final layer 3 (state 607856bb4057…) — every cursor position is the engine's own recorded state, never a client-side snapshot

steps.title: Validate (the deterministic server-side checks)
steps.detail: validated version 1 through the engine's deterministic Validate — outcome 'pass' over 7 checks (engine aise-solution-engine 1.0.0); the snapshot certifies the version's exact bytes (inputDigest 72fa03815e81…)

steps.title: Generate the solution BOQ
steps.detail: generated the solution BOQ from the declared validation snapshot — 7 line(s) across 3 section(s), every quantity engine-sourced with its calculation reference; the derived projection never overwrites a source BOQ
